rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: Codex renders no trust dialog of its own for a launch, so the gate is never consulted for it. A plain Enter submits. An idle codex animates a braille starfield around its ghost suggestion, so those cells are recognised by shape and stripped, never by luminance. One Escape cancels the turn and leaves the composer empty, so no clear key and no arm signal are needed. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. While a turn runs the pane carries `esc to interrupt` with a rotating spinner word and an elapsed cell; idle it carries no elapsed cell. Busy is read from the lifecycle hooks, never from that footer.
